text:
Show code
library(tidyverse)




Show code
taylor_album_songs <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2023/2023-10-17/taylor_album_songs.csv')
taylor_all_songs <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2023/2023-10-17/taylor_all_songs.csv')
taylor_albums <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2023/2023-10-17/taylor_albums.csv')




Show code
taylor_all_songs |>
    filter(!is.na(album_name), !is.na(duration_ms)) |>
    mutate(minutes = duration_ms / 60000) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = minutes, y = album_name)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(
    y = "Song length (minutes)",
    title = "Taylor Swift song length by album",
    caption = "Source: TidyTuesday 2023-10-17 (taylor R package)"
  )











Show code
taylor_all_songs |>
  drop_na(album_name, duration_ms) |>
  mutate(minutes = duration_ms / 60000) |>
  group_by(album_name) |>
  summarize(median_min = median(minutes), n_songs = n()) |>
  arrange(median_min)


# A tibble: 13 × 3
   album_name                          median_min n_songs
   <chr>                                    <dbl>   <int>
 1 The Taylor Swift Holiday Collection       3.27       6
 2 Lover                                     3.32      18
 3 Midnights                                 3.39      20
 4 Taylor Swift                              3.55      15
 5 reputation                                3.80      15
 6 1989                                      3.85      16
 7 folklore                                  3.9       17
 8 Red                                       3.98      22
 9 Red (Taylor's Version)                    4.03      30
10 Fearless (Taylor's Version)               4.03      26
11 Fearless                                  4.07      19
12 evermore                                  4.08      17
13 Speak Now                                 4.43      17


This boxplot shows the distribution of Taylor Swift’s song lengths in minutes for each album. Speak Now has the longest median song length of 4.43 minutes, while Taylor Swift Holiday Collection has the shortest median song lengh of 3.27. The biggest outlier is on Red (Taylor’s Version), at just over 10 minutes, which is the 10-minute version of “All Too Well.
Data source: TidyTuesday 2023-10-17: Taylor Swift songs
Original source: Thompson W (2026). taylor: Lyrics and Song Data for Taylor Swift’s Discography. R package version 4.0.0, https://taylor.wjakethompson.com.
